facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The trace was followed through 16 of 20 slices and stays on the clicked layer, with 96.0% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 3.1 voxels, so it can be trusted as a broad guide to the sheet. It is weakest for fine detail, with only 17.0% within 2 voxels. Please check the red line against the yellow dot in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19 for places where the line leaves the bright layer or jumps to a neighbour.
